data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 3/6): Handle litellm response.usage shape (NOT Anthropic-native). dispatch.py uses litellm.completion — usage is OpenAI-shape (response.usage.prompt_tokens, response.usage.completion_tokens). Story description says 'Anthropic API usage.input_tokens' which is wrong. AC must specify: read .prompt_tokens as input_tokens, .completion_tokens as output_tokens, guard cache fields with getattr(usage, 'cache_read_input_tokens', None). RED test must use litellm-shaped mock, not Anthropic-native.
